ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad black borders at the distal and medial margins with high-density dark mottling and focal spots concentrated in the central regions of both lobes, contrasted against a white base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (10-30 pixels) along the entire trailing edge, with the highest complexity located at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a steep upward sweep toward the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, textured nodes visible at the extreme left and right tips; a distinct dark circular cluster is present in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent dark linear streaks traversing the white regions, including diagonal marks on the left lobe and intersecting horizontal/diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge wear and multiple linear rake marks distributed across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark ring-like spot located in the upper-medial region of the right fluke lobe.
